methods: Own official code binds the unchanged entity; v4 name/item/point/state continuity is checked individually. GB removed ambiguous items and previously corrected states are independently bound by the same v4 name and original point to the exact NRS locality code. Only type, type_local and proved depth change. No seat substitution, new links or finer subtype is inferred.
